verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented account quotas or per-account instance limits, and no defined process for requesting a limit increase. The closest items are API request rate limits (1 req/s, launches limited per 12s), cluster size ranges (16–512 GPUs), and a sales contact for reserved capacity. These are adjacent features, not quota documentation or a quota-raise workflow.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can see documented quotas and instance limits and raise them through a defined process
